Events

Activities and events

We offer several different types of events to our member countries that are aimed at increasing capacity building, mutual learning, and exchange.

11

Annual Meeting

The group’s flagship event is hosted by a different member country each year. It includes international discussions, training, and a national seminar for the host country to debate policy issues.

 9

Workshops

We organise and facilitate in-depth workshops, as well as national seminars for stakeholders to debate policy direction.

 10

Training sessions

Training is delivered in person in a member country or in an interactive live format online.

 19

Virtual meetings

We organise online seminars and trainings.
